topic: A trip to a tea village
passage: Last Sunday, my wife and I visited a small tea village in the mountains. Although the road was narrow and the bus moved slowly, we arrived before noon because we had set out very early in the morning. When we walked through the village, we smelled fresh tea leaves and heard farmers talking in the fields. An old farmer welcomed us and showed us how to pick tea leaves with our hands. He explained that we should pick only the soft top leaves and leave the hard ones on the plants. We followed him into the fields and picked leaves one by one. At noon, we sat down in his small house and tasted three kinds of tea. The tea tasted light and sweet, and my wife said it was much better than the tea we buy in the supermarket. Before we left, we bought two bags of tea and thanked the farmer for his help. On the way home, we talked about the quiet village and promised to return in the spring when the new leaves come out.

coach_rationale: 今天继续盯本周重点：过去式 -ed 结尾听辨，同时加练连读弱项——passage 里埋了 set out、walked through、picked leaves、sat down 四组动词短语连读靶子，听写时 -ed 的 /t/、/d/ 音不要漏。B1 第四天，继续用 although/because 复合句加压，话题换成没练过的茶乡之旅。

-ed 在浊音后读 /d/，别漏掉尾音
-ed 在 t 音后读 /ɪd/，多一个音节，别吞掉
